title: Quaint Velvety Japanese Scallops Noodles
description: A nutty and velvety Japanese dish featuring balsamic vinegar and shio-koji-cure, perfect for a festive meal. This raw-friendly recipe highlights the freshness of scallops and noodles.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the soba noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the shio-koji, balsamic vinegar, and sesame oil to make the sauce.
Pat the scallops dry with paper towels and season with salt and black pepper.
In a large skillet, sear the scallops over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, seared scallops, and shio-koji sauce.
Toss everything together to coat the noodles and scallops with the sauce.
Garnish with green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
